market_outlook.short_term: Markets constructive on tech momentum and oil-driven energy strength. Asian stocks gaining on tech optimism. Key risk: Hormuz escalation could spike oil to $110-120, triggering inflation fears. US-China summit this week is pivotal—positive outcome supports risk-on; negative triggers tariff escalation. Crypto at 8-month highs suggests risk appetite intact. Watch for midterm election noise.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle (data centers > housing) supports 12-18 month tech outperformance. Energy transition (nuclear, EVs, electric two-wheelers) creating structural winners. Venezuela oil reopening adds 1-2M bpd by 2027, capping oil upside. M&A super-cycle (Paramount-WB, KKR) continues. CRE distress in secondary markets persists. Political risk from Trump admin and midterms creates episodic volatility but not trend reversal.
